description: This is a Java test source file that implements a mock factory for MQTT clients based on HiveMQ for unit testing purposes. It provides methods to simulate MQTT client behavior, manage messages, handle exceptions, and verify interactions.

classes.name: MockHiveMqtt3ClientFactory
classes.description: A mock factory class that simulates HiveMQ MQTT client interactions for testing purposes. It supports simulating connection failures, message handling, and client behaviors.

methods.name: getCreatedClientCount
methods.description: Returns the number of MQTT clients created and connected by this factory.

methods.name: withException
methods.description: Configures the factory to throw a specified exception during connection attempts.

methods.name: withMessage
methods.description: Adds a single MQTT publish message to the internal message store for a specific topic.

methods.name: withMessages
methods.description: Adds multiple MQTT publish messages to the internal message store.

methods.name: withTestProbe
methods.description: Assigns an ActorRef probe for observing messages during tests.

methods.name: withFailingSubscribe
methods.description: Configures the subscribe operation to fail with an exception.

methods.name: expectDisconnectCalled
methods.description: Verifies that disconnect was called on all created clients.

methods.name: newClient
methods.description: Creates a mocked MQTT client with specified behaviors, including handle connection, disconnection, subscription, and publishing.

methods.name: newClientBuilder
methods.description: Returns a builder that produces the mocked MQTT client.
